title: ci(test-shards): Test Core's two slowest shards set every core PR's wall clock at ~28 min (5.6 min dependency build + ~20 min tests) while the other six finish in 7–17 — re-derive the cli slicing and shard balance on post-merge readings
body:
Ruled: 6439314592 · letter A (re-ruled from B, 6435350063) · 2026-10-27T10:22Z

Filing gate ③ (maintainer-directed). Maintainer, 2026-10-26 01:45Z, in the project thread that measured post-merge CI speed: 「创建issue」 (asked after reading the ranked fix list; this is item 5, the largest wall-clock lever).

**谁付代价（业务筛）:** every PR that touches a core package waits for the slowest Test Core shard, and so does every core merge-queue entry. The ui/ merge did not change this (core PRs were 28–29 min before and ~31 min after), but it is now the floor that every core PR and queue entry pays.

## Measured (`pull_request` runs, 2026-10-25/26)

| run | slowest shards | other shards |
|---|---|---|
| 40211990811 | 5/8 27.6 min, 4/8 18.2 | 8.4–17.0 |
| 40211391950 | 4/8 28.1, 5/8 27.4 | 7.7–17.1 |
| 40219925686 | 5/8 27.8, 4/8 27.3, 3/8 25.3 | 7.5–16.8 |
| 40248884869 | 4/8 29.6, 5/8 23.4 | 7.3–17.8 |

- On the long shards, "Build this shard's dependencies" takes 5.3–5.8 min and "Run this shard's tests" 20–22 min. On the short ones the build is 0.3–0.9 min.
- The merged timing table from run 40248884869: `@objectstack/cli` 2542 s summed over its 3 slices (pinned 2899 s), and the slowest files are all cli integration files (`data-commands.absent-database.integration.test.ts` 364 s, `stack-conversion-record-door.test.ts` 330 s, …). Many other packages run at 0.35–0.6× their pinned weight (objectql 0.35×, metadata-protocol 0.52×), so the dataset over-weights them and under-fills other legs.

## Wanted

- Find out what makes 3/8–5/8 long: the cli slices, the dependency closure they build (5.6 min against <1 min elsewhere), or stale weights.
- Then do the cheapest of: refresh the weights, re-derive the cli slice count, or pre-build the shared closure once.
- ⛔ No test skipped or quarantined, and no timeout raised to make it fit.

## Acceptance

- Slowest Test Core shard ≤ ~20 min on 3 consecutive `pull_request` runs that touch `packages/spec`. Readings go on the card.

**Expected saving:** ~8 min wall clock per core PR and per core queue entry. **Size:** M. **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none.

## Dedupe

`search_issues` 2026-10-26 01:50Z 「Test Core shard long pole 4/8 5/8 rebalance shard timings wall clock」: 11 hits, all closed. Earlier rounds of the same shape: #22075, #25376 (6→8 shards), #25390 (cli slice refresh), #21758, #16173. Nothing open. **New.**

Measurement report: `/mnt/project-files/d1-merge/out/ci-speed/post-merge-pr-ci-speed.md`.
